text: Unit two built the exponential series from the limit for e. Here it is at work. The white curve is e to the x. One term of the series is a flat line; two terms a straight line; three a parabola. Each new term bends the yellow curve closer, and by six or seven terms it hugs e to the x across the whole picture.
